sequencing: Frozen before any lab label distribution was read by an estimator fit. Mapping decisions use only the implemented-idea registry and raw source availability/schema; target labels are not estimator inputs.

staged_lab_raw_inputs.scope: only bbox-overlapping row groups for accepted external lab tracts; no reference target used
reference labels only; never an estimator input

measured_absent_from_current_stage: the challenge-provided roads-unfiltered layer and the organizer-filtered road layer as shipped
Overture transportation access_restrictions/oneway and routes columns
strata/ACS/Census attributes ALAND, population density, RUCA, CarbonPlan building counts, package building counts, hazard and tribal flags
raw_source_inventory.decision_basis: Input registry and staged source manifests/file schemas only; no lab labels or label distributions were opened or used to choose these mappings.

filter.geometry: WKB projected to EPSG:5070; clip only to the external lab tract polygon or its specified boundary buffer

input_mappings.filter: external lab group tracts only; same group polygon used for clipping

G1.recipe: For each lab tract, compute f_b = selected road-class length within the ±25m tract-boundary band divided by selected road-class length within the tract plus its 25m exterior buffer. Emit 0.5*f_b as the R gap covariate; undefined only when denominator is zero.

filter.geometry: WKB projected to EPSG:5070; clip only to the external lab tract polygon or its specified boundary buffer
filter.names_presence: non-empty string anywhere in Overture names structure; unnamed iff absent/empty

Sc1.recipe: For each lab tract, emit unnamed selected-class road length / total selected-class road length; undefined only when total length is zero.

G2.reason: Requires access_restrictions/oneway, route or same-name heading pairs; these columns are absent from the staged Overture road schema.

G3.reason: Requires building geometry/source provenance and a Microsoft-only area reference; no Overture building table is staged, and the prohibited reference building layer is not used as an estimator input.

G4.reason: Requires a building-centroid grid plus park/school POIs and water infrastructure masks; those source themes are absent from staging.

G5.reason: Requires place names/coordinates and building allocation; the Overture places/buildings themes are absent from staging.

Tm1.reason: Requires historical CarbonPlan building counts and the package building count; neither exists for external lab groups.

X1.reason: Requires building witnesses plus Overture place categories; both source themes are absent from staging.

X3.reason: Requires commercial place categories and building footprints; those source themes are absent from staging.

X4.reason: Requires building centroids and named road networks; building theme is absent, and staged road fields do not supply the required full named-road connectivity analogue.

X5.reason: Requires Overture infrastructure subtype/source tags and EMS place locations; both themes are absent from staging.

Dst1.reason: Requires place categories and reference facility/establishment counts; place theme and corresponding external raw source mapping are absent from this staged build.

Dst2.reason: Requires places.sources.dataset multi-membership and categories; the places theme is absent from staging.

Dst3.reason: Requires Overture building areas; the buildings theme is absent from staging.

registry_inputs: the outputs of the other ideas
Dst4.reason: Consumes outputs of other estimators; no complete upstream estimator matrix exists in this lab build, so computing it would be a post-hoc synthetic feature.

registry_inputs: the rules text and our estimators
Dst5.reason: Consumes rules text and derived estimator definitions rather than an independently measurable raw public-source signal; no faithful raw-source tract analogue exists.

Mx4.reason: Requires buildings.sources provider-level Esri share; Overture buildings and its sources field are absent from staging.

Sc2.reason: Requires place names/categories/taxonomy; the places theme is absent from staging.

Sc3.reason: Requires alternate place taxonomy/category fields; the places theme is absent from staging.

Sc4.reason: Requires roads-unfiltered with route/name and >2km geometry filters; only the four-class Overture road subset is staged, not the challenge unfiltered layer.

Sc5.reason: Requires both organizer-filtered and unfiltered roads exactly as shipped; neither paired package layer exists for external lab tracts, and recreating the organizer filter would be speculative.

Sca1.reason: Requires λ from expectation estimators and observed component inputs; its upstream facility/building estimators are not evaluable in this lab source snapshot.

P1.reason: Requires buildings with area/height/class plus place locations; building and places themes are absent from staging.

P2.reason: Requires ALAND, population density and RUCA source attributes; only tract geometry is staged, not ACS/RUCA feature tables.

P3.reason: Requires building height/geometry and road context; the building theme is absent from staging.

P4.reason: Requires RUCA and ALAND alongside road measurements; RUCA/area feature attributes are not staged, so the road-only input is not a faithful complete analogue.

policy: No reference-layer measurement is ever used as an estimator input. TIGER 2024 roads are labels only; X2 is excluded. Only feature-side raw measurements enter estimators.parquet.

X2.reason: Steward ruling 2026-10-26 identifies usfs_BuildingCount_sum as an equivalent copy of a removed reference count; the field/layer must not be read or computed.
